title: Battlestar React-ica: Katee Sackhoff's First Watch of BSG
author: Katee Sackhoff - Starbuck from Battlestar Galactica
description: Actress Katee Sackhoff (aka Starbuck) returns to Battlestar Galactica -- not just to discuss it after the fact -- but to actually watch and react to every episode in real time alongside the audience. Part watch-along, part commentary track, part comedy podcast, Battlestar React-ica brings back the communal experience of DVD commentary for the streaming era.
